payload.entry: Root causes (product vs test): (1) Open Hint chip was gated on primaryActionEnabled/grammar, hiding it with no preview yet and with legacy previewResults; product now shows the chip whenever hasDraft and the plan is available, still disabling the button until Capture is enabled. (2) Explicit completion splice of replacement "cash" over "Call @ca" range (6,8) yields "Call @cash"; tests waited for "Call cash". Client-replaced case now uses setProcessClient so the new bob re-parses. (3) Template list first row fieldCount is 1 in capture-templates-list-populated.json. Delete record raced optimistic local removal; wait now includes argv=capture-templates delete. Command-S refusal now expects bob copy "add `%t` to the draft's first item to save it as a template". (4) Unselected type menu Tab uses fixture replacement "#build" (no trailing space); Up selects last of the six fixture rows. portable-check on athena: 1898 tests, 0 failures. just docs-check passed. Mac scratch typecheck skipped (mac SSH timed out). macos-ci-check next.

CI 41291891532 SHA dfdd52e: 11 of 12 gone. Remaining of the twelve: testExplicitCompletionSubmitIsCanceledWhenBobClientIsReplaced timed out at :525 because setProcessClient left suppressedCompletionAcceptanceDraft set, so editorTextDidChange returned without re-parsing. NEW: testTwoClipboardChangesSupersedeOlderPreviewsForTheSameDraft got second newest (fake-bob dry-run sequence file race; passed on master 41289488292). f3 seven all still failed. Fixes: clear suppression on client replace; lock dry-run sequence increment; waitUntil requires newest lines. portable-check 1898 ok. Re-running macos-ci-check.

drawer-writes landed: separate #type retypes +id target in same transaction (D8 relocation, one atomic batch); blank-line on drawer creation fixed (header no longer double-newlines, simplified create branch); parent_section replaced by drawer {title,key,created} (null for plain child) with human 'new drawer' + type row; drawer spans carry title/key; refusal codes for invalid_drawer/drawer_text/ambiguous/reserved/near_duplicate/drawer_toggle/R3; drawer_near_catalog warning via capture warnings. Verified: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test cli 2605 passed, cargo test --lib capture_language 444 passed, just docs-check passed (447), git grep parent_section clean, landing smokes for writes (retype BUILD->FIX, new-drawer bytes without blank line, drawer_text/reserved/near_duplicate/ambiguous codes, warning, toggle code) pass. No Cargo.toml/CHANGELOG edits.

CI 41293639210 SHA 77e056239a792471c597eaa349cd1108a99fae28: all twelve mac-ci-regressions XCTests passed. Failed tests are exactly the bob-cli-f3 seven baseline (testToggleLineCaseUndoRestoresOriginalLine, testTaskTypeRetypeMoveKeepsDraftAndUsesEnsureNextAction, testPlusAfterCaretIDSwitchesToSubBulletInOneUndoStep, testPlusToggleUndoRestoresLiteralPostKeyDraftOnce, testTypedPlusAsWholeItemOpensActiveTaskPickerThroughKeyIntent, testBareLeadingTrailingAndChildMarkersOpenTaskTypeMenu, testTypedRowDoesNotWriteVisibility). No new failures. Prior remaining of the twelve (testExplicitCompletionSubmitIsCanceledWhenBobClientIsReplaced timeout) and the sequence-race clip preview test from 41291891532 are gone. macos-ci-check exit 1 is the allowed f3 baseline. epic-symbols: none.
